paragraphs: Founded by our Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer, Martine Rothblatt, to find a cure for her daughter's life-threatening rare disease, pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), United Therapeutics advances therapies for people living with serious diseases with unmet medical needs. Our mission is to transform the treatment of rare diseases and expand the availability of transplantable organs through innovative organ manufacturing technologies.

As a public benefit corporation (PBC), we aim to deliver meaningful impacts for our patients, our people, our shareholders, and other stakeholders. Our public benefit purpose, as outlined in our charter and approved by our shareholders, is to provide a brighter future for patients through (a) the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and (b) technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.
We market and sell the following commercial therapies in the United States to treat PAH: •Tyvaso DPI® (treprostinil) Inhalation Powder (Tyvaso DPI);
•Tyvaso® (treprostinil) Inhalation Solution (Nebulized Tyvaso), which includes the Tyvaso Inhalation System;
•Remodulin® (treprostinil) Injection (Remodulin); and the Remunity® and RemunityPRO™ Pumps for Remodulin (Remunity);
•Orenitram® (treprostinil) Extended-Release Tablets (Orenitram); and

In the United States, we also market and sell an oncology product, Unituxin® (dinutuximab) Injection (Unituxin), which is approved by the FDA for the treatment of high-risk neuroblastoma. Outside the United States, we derive revenues from sales of Nebulized Tyvaso, Remodulin, and Unituxin.

Our principal executive offices are located at 1000 Spring Street, Silver Spring, Maryland 20910 and at 55 T.W. Alexander Drive, Durham, North Carolina 27713. Unless the context requires otherwise or unless otherwise noted, all references in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (this Report) to "United Therapeutics" and to the "company", "we", "us" or "our" are to United Therapeutics Corporation and its subsidiaries.

Investing in our securities involves uncertainty and risk due to a variety of factors. You should carefully consider each of the following risks and all of the other information contained in this Report and in other documents that we file with, or furnish to, the SEC before making any investment decision with respect to our securities. Statements in this section are based on our beliefs and opinions regarding matters that could materially adversely affect us in the future and are not representations as to whether such matters have or have not occurred previously. Further, the risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face and should not be considered a complete statement of all potential risks or uncertainties that we face or may face in the future. Additional risks not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also materially affect our business.
Risks Related to Our Products and Our Operations
We rely heavily on sales of our treprostinil-based therapies to generate revenues and support our operations.

Sales of our treprostinil-based therapies — Tyvaso DPI, Nebulized Tyvaso, Remodulin, and Orenitram — comprise the vast majority of our revenues. Substantially decreased sales of any of these products could have a material adverse impact on our operations. A wide variety of events, such as withdrawal of regulatory approvals or substantial changes in prescribing practices or dosing patterns, many of which are described in other risk factors below, could cause sales of these products to materially decline, or to grow more slowly than expected. Our net revenues could also be negatively impacted by pricing pressure as a result of competitive challenges, the IRA, and other drug price reduction initiatives. The availability of generic versions of our products has negatively impacted our revenues, and these and additional generic products launched in the future may continue to do so. The approval and launch of new therapies may materially negatively impact sales of our current and potential new products. Sales may decrease if any third party that manufactures, markets, distributes, or sells our commercial products cannot do so satisfactorily, or we cannot manage our internal manufacturing processes. Finally, if demand for our Tyvaso products does not meet our expectations, the revenue opportunity for our treprostinil products could be significantly lower than we expect.
If our products fail in clinical trials, we will be unable to sell those products.

To obtain approvals from the FDA and international regulatory agencies to sell new products, to expand the product labeling for our existing products, or to launch new delivery devices for our existing products, we must conduct clinical trials demonstrating that our products are safe and effective. Regulators have substantial discretion over the approval process. Regulators may require us to amend ongoing trials or perform additional trials, which have in the past and could in the future result in significant delays and additional costs and may be unsuccessful. Delays and costs associated with regulatory requirements to change or add trials have sometimes caused us to discontinue efforts to develop a particular product, and may do so again in the future. If our clinical trials are not successful, or we fail to address identified deficiencies adequately, we will not obtain required approvals to market the new product or new indication. We cannot predict with certainty how long it will take, or how much it will cost, to complete necessary clinical trials or obtain regulatory approvals of our current or future products. The time and cost needed to complete clinical trials and obtain regulatory approvals varies by product, indication, and country. In addition, failure to obtain, or delays in obtaining, regulatory approval has in the past and could in the future require us to recognize impairment charges.

The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations and other sections of this Report contain forward-looking statements made pursuant to the safe harbor provisions of Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These statements, which are based on our beliefs and expectations about future outcomes and on information available to us through the date this Report on Form 10-K is filed with the SEC, include, among others, statements related to the following:

•Expectations of revenues, expenses, profitability, cash flows, and growth in the number of patients being treated with our products, including continued growth in sales of Tyvaso DPI, and anticipated growth in the number of patients with PH-ILD being treated with our Tyvaso products;
•The sufficiency of our cash on hand to support operations; •Our ability to obtain and maintain domestic and international regulatory approvals;

•Our ability to maintain attractive pricing and reimbursement levels for our products, in light of increasing competition, including from generic products, and pressure from government and other payers to decrease the costs associated with healthcare, including the potential impact of the IRA on our business and the Trump administration's most favored nation pricing initiatives;

•The expected volume and timing of sales of our commercial products, as well as potential future commercial products, including the anticipated effect of various research and development efforts on sales of these products;
•The timing and outcome of clinical studies, other research and development efforts, and related regulatory filings and approvals;

•The outcome of pending and potential future legal and regulatory actions by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and other regulatory and government enforcement agencies related to our products and potential competitive products;

•The timing and outcome of ongoing litigation, including the lawsuit filed against us by Sandoz and Liquidia PAH, LLC (formerly known as RareGen); our patent and trade secret litigation with Liquidia related to Yutrepia; Liquidia's patent lawsuit against us related to Tyvaso DPI; and our litigation with Humana Inc., United Healthcare Services, Inc., MSP Recovery Claims, Series LLC, and related entities;

•The impact of competing therapies on sales of our commercial products, including the impact of generic versions of Remodulin; established therapies such as Uptravi®; and newer therapies such as Merck's Winrevair and Liquidia's Yutrepia;

•The expectation that we will be able to manufacture sufficient quantities and maintain adequate inventories of our commercial products, through both our in-house manufacturing capabilities and third-party manufacturing sites (including our plans to expand manufacturing capacity for Tyvaso DPI);

•Expectations regarding the amount and timing of capital expenditures to construct new facilities to support our product development and commercialization efforts, including our xenotransplantation-related facilities;
•Expectations regarding the timing and impact of our business development efforts;
•The adequacy of our intellectual property protection and the validity and expiration dates of the patents we own or license, as well as the regulatory exclusivity periods for our products;

paragraphs: 由本公司董事長兼首席執行長 Martine Rothblatt 資助成立，旨在為其女兒的致命罕見疾病肺動脈 hypertension (PAH) 尋找療法，United Therapeutics 推動對患有嚴重且未被滿足醫療需求疾病的患者之療法。本公司之使命為轉變罕見疾病的治療方式，並透過創新器官製造技術擴大可移植器官之可得性。
作為一家公共利益公司 (PBC)，我們致力於為患者、員工、股東及其他利害關係人帶來實質影響。根據我們章程所載並經股東批准之公共利益目的為：透過 (a) 開發創新藥物療法；以及 (b) 擴大可移植器官之可得性之技術，為患者創造更光明的未來。
我們在美國市場銷售以下商業療法用以治療 PAH：•Tyvaso DPI® (treprostinil) 吸入粉末 (Tyvaso DPI)；
•Tyvaso® (treprostin,il) 吸入溶液 (Nebulized Tyvaso)，包含 Tyvaso 吸入系統；
•Remodulin® (treprostinil) 注射劑 (Remodulin)；以及 Remunity® 和 RemunityPRO™ 電動泵用以注射 Remodulin (Remunity)；
•Orenitram® (treprostinil) 延長釋放片劑 (Orenitram)；以及
在美國，我們亦市場銷售一種腫瘤產品 Unituxin® (dinutuximab) 注射劑 (Unituxin)，此產品已獲得 FDA 批准用以治療高風險神經母細胞瘤。在美國以外地區，我們透過銷售 Nebulized Tyvaso、Remodulin 及 Unituxin 來產生收入。

本公司主要營業據點位於馬裏蘭州銀泉市 Spring Street 1000 號及北卡羅萊納州杜蘭德市 T.W. Alexander Drive 55 號。除非文意另有要求或另有說明，否則本年度報告表 10-K（本報告）中所有提及 "United Therapeutics" 及 "公司"、"我們"、"我們" 或 "我們" 之參考，均指 United Therapeutics Corporation 及其子公司。

paragraphs: 以下討論應配合我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀。所有本檔中的陳述均為於本報告提交至美國證券交易委員會（SEC）之日所作出。本公司對公開更新或修正這些陳述概無義務，無論是否因新資訊、未來事件或其他因素所致。

以下「管理層討論與分析」（Management's Discussion and Analysis）及財務狀況與營運成果之分析，以及本報告其他部分，包含根據1934年證券交易法第21E條款之安全港條款及1995年私人證券 litigation 改革法案所作出之預測性陳述。這些陳述係基於我們對未來結果的信念與預期，以及截至本10-K表格報告提交至美國證券交易委員會（SEC）之日所掌握的資訊，包含但不限於以下相關陳述：
•對我們產品之收入、費用、利潤率、現金流及接受治療病患數量之預期，包括Tyvaso DPI銷售之持續成長，以及預期接受Tyvaso產品治療之PH-ILD病患數量之成長；
•我們現金餘額是否足以支應營運；•我們能否取得並維持國內外監管機構之核准；
•我們能否在面對日益激烈的競爭，包括來自仿製藥品的競爭，以及政府及其他付款方對降低醫療成本之壓力下，維持具吸引力的產品價格與報銷水準，包括IRA對我們業務之潛在影響，以及特朗普政府之最優惠國別價格倡議措施之影響；
•我們商業產品之銷售數量與時程，以及潛在未來商業產品之預期，包括各種研究與開發努力對這些產品銷售之預期影響；
•臨牀試驗、其他研究與開發努力，以及相關監管申報與核准之時程與結果；
•美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）及其他監管與政府執法機構對我們產品及潛在競爭產品之待決及未來法律與監管行動之結果；

•訴訟發生的時間與結果，包括本公司被 Sandoz 和 Liquidia PAH, LLC（ formerly known as RareGen）提起的訴訟；與 Liquidia 有關 Yutrepia 的專利與商業機密訴訟；Liquidia 對本公司就 Tyvaso DPI 提起的專利訴訟；以及本公司與 Humana Inc.、United Healthcare Services, Inc.、MSP Recovery Claims, Series LLC 及相關機構的訴訟；
•競爭性療法對本公司商業產品銷售的影響，包括 Remodulin 的仿製藥版本；已建立的療法如 Uptravi®；以及較新的療法如 Merck 的 Winrevair 和 Liquidia 的 Yutrepia；
•本公司預期能夠製造足夠數量的商業產品並維持充足的存貨，透過本公司內部製造能力及第三方製造場地（包括本公司擴充 Tyvaso DPI 製造能力的計畫）；
•關於建設新設施以支持產品開發與商業化工作的資本支出金額與時間的預期，包括與異種移植相關的設施；
•關於本公司業務發展工作的時間與影響的預期；
•本公司智慧財產權保護的充分性，以及本公司擁有或授權的專利有效性與到期日，以及本公司產品的藥物專利保護期間；

投資本公司證券涉及不確定性與風險，係因多種因素所致。您應仔細考量下列各項風險，以及本報告及其他我們向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交或提供之文件中所包含之所有資訊，再做任何有關本公司證券之投資決定。本節之陳述係基於我們對可能對我們未來產生重大不利影響之事項之信念與意見，並非表示這些事項是否已發生過。此外，下列所描述之風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨之唯一風險，亦不應視為我們目前或未來可能面臨之所有潛在風險或不確定性之完整陳述。尚有其他風險，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，亦可能對我們之業務產生重大影響。
與我們產品及營運相關之風險
我們嚴重依賴treprostinil基質療法之銷售來產生收入並支撐營運。

我們treprostinil基質療法之銷售 — Tyvaso DPI、Nebulized Tyvaso、Remodulin 及 Orenitram — 約佔我們收入之絕大多數。若這些產品之銷售大幅減少，將對我們營運產生重大不利影響。許多可能導致這些產品銷售大幅下降，或成長速度低於預期之事件，例如撤回監管許可或大幅改變處方習慣或用藥模式，許多已在其他風險因素中說明。我們之淨收入亦可能因競爭挑戰、IRA 及其他藥物價格減免計畫所導致之價格壓力而受到負面影響。我們產品之仿製藥版本之上市已對我們收入造成負面影響，這些及未來可能上市之其他仿製藥亦可能持續造成影響。新療法之核准與上市可能對我們現有及潛在新產品之銷售產生重大負面影響。若任何製造、行銷、分銷或銷售我們商業產品之第三方無法妥善執行，或我們無法管理內部製造流程，銷售可能減少。最後，若我們Tyvaso產品之需求未達預期，則我們treprostinil產品之收入機會可能遠低於預期。
若我們產品在臨牀試驗中失敗，我們將無法銷售這些產品。

為取得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）及國際監管機構核准銷售新產品、擴展現有產品之標籤，或發佈現有產品之新給藥裝置，我們必須進行臨牀試驗以證明我們產品之安全性與有效性。監管機構對核准程序有相當大的裁量權。監管機構可能要求我們修改進行中之試驗或執行額外試驗，這些在過去及未來可能導致重大延宕與額外成本，且可能失敗。與監管機構要求修改或增加試驗相關之延宕與成本，有時已導致我們放棄開發特定產品之努力，未來亦可能再次發生。若我們之臨牀試驗未成功，或我們未能充分解決已識別之缺失，我們將無法取得新產品或新適應症之核准。我們無法確定完成必要臨牀試驗或取得目前或未來產品之監管核准所需時間或成本。完成臨牀試驗及取得監管核准所需時間與成本因產品、適應症及國家而異。此外，未能取得或延宕取得核准，過去已導致我們需認列減損費用，未來亦可能如此。
